cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(StudySteadySDLAudioChecks LANGUAGES CXX)
get_filename_component(STUDYSTEADY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
find_package(SDL3 CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(sdl_pcm_stream_test ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../native/platform/sdl/sdl_pcm_stream.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../unit/platform/sdl_pcm_stream_test.cpp)
target_compile_features(sdl_pcm_stream_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(sdl_pcm_stream_test PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME sdl_pcm_stream COMMAND sdl_pcm_stream_test)
add_executable(image_codec_test ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../native/platform/sdl/image_codec.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../unit/platform/image_codec_test.cpp)
target_compile_features(image_codec_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(image_codec_test PRIVATE ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/vendor/official-tinygltf)
target_link_libraries(image_codec_test PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3)
add_test(NAME image_codec COMMAND image_codec_test)
add_executable(sdl_presentation_smoke sdl_presentation_smoke.cpp)
target_compile_features(sdl_presentation_smoke PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(sdl_presentation_smoke PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3)

target_include_directories(sdl_pcm_stream_test PRIVATE "${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/native")
target_include_directories(image_codec_test PRIVATE "${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/native")
target_include_directories(sdl_presentation_smoke PRIVATE "${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/native")
